optio_gaius.name: Optio Gaius
optio_gaius.examine: The cohort's optio. He has the look of a man who has counted a great many recruits.
idle: Keep your blade clean and your mouth shut, and the auxilia will make something of you.

tiro.name: Tiro
tiro.summary: Enlist in the auxilia at Castra Ferrea and prove you can fight with blade, sling, and curse.
start: Another peregrinus looking for a future? Good. The Emperor needs auxilia more than he needs another farmer.
Serve twenty-five years and you leave a citizen. Serve badly and you leave in a box.
First I want to see you fight. Here: a sling, some lead, a lituus, and a few binding tablets. Don't lose them.
Strike the training dummy with your blade. Then with the sling. Then curse it, if you have the stomach for it.

steps.log: Strike the training dummy six times with a melee weapon.
remind: The dummy is by the forum. Six good blows with a blade. Go on.

steps.log: Wield the sling and hit the training dummy five times.
remind: Wield the sling, wear the lead as ammunition, and put five into the dummy.

steps.log: Wield the lituus and curse the training dummy three times.
remind: Lituus in hand, tablets ready. Three curses on the dummy. The Manes won't mind; it's only straw.

steps.log: Kill three of the rats in the granary.
remind: The granary rats are eating the cohort's grain. Kill three and we'll call it your first campaign.

complete: Three rats. The poets will sing of it. Still, you did what you were told, and that's rarer than courage.
From today you're a tiro of the cohort. Take this parma; it's seen better arms than yours.
When you've the coin, the quartermaster's stores are open to you. Iron, not bronze. Look after it.
